Notifies the players, saves everything and stops the server. Also with Shift+F5.
Borra la cuenta elegida con su personaje: Deletes the selected account with its character, its properties and its place in the gang. It can't be undone.
Borra lo que hay en esta ventana. No bor: Clears what is in this window. It doesn't delete anything from the server.
Cambia el aviso que oye cada jugador al: Changes the notice each player hears on joining.
Cierra el panel. Si el servidor está en: Closes the panel. If the server is running, it stops it first.
Configuración guardada. Valdrá en cuanto: Settings saved. They will take effect as soon as you start the server.
Copia al portapapeles el código elegido,: Copies the selected code to the clipboard, so you can send it to whoever you want to invite.
Copia al portapapeles la dirección de es: Copies this server's address on your network to the clipboard, to give to whoever plays in your home.
Copiada la dirección %s. Vale para quien: Address %s copied. It works for whoever plays in your home; for people playing from outside, see the guide with F1.
Crea un código de invitación de un solo: Creates a single-use invitation code and copies it to the clipboard.
Crea un código nuevo, de un solo uso, y: Creates a new single-use code and copies it to the clipboard. Also with Ctrl+I.
Código de invitación, de un solo uso:\n%:
Single-use invitation code:
%s

It is already copied to the clipboard: paste it into a message to whoever you want to invite.
It is only needed if entry to the server is by invitation; you choose that in Settings, on the Access and administration tab.
Cómo está el servidor: si está en marcha: How the server is doing: whether it is running, how many people are in, the port, the address for your friends, the encryption and the world it works with. One item per line. It updates by itself when something changes; F6 updates it right away.
Deja los datos como estaban en una copia: Puts the data back as it was in a backup. The server must be stopped.
Dice algo a todos los jugadores que está: Says something to all the players who are inside.
Says something to everyone who is inside. Also with Ctrl+N.
Dice algo solo al jugador elegido en la: Says something only to the player selected in the players list.
Dice algo solo al jugador elegido. Tambi: Says something only to the selected player. Also with Ctrl+M.
Dice los atajos de teclado de esta venta: Reads out the keyboard shortcuts of this window.
Dirección para quien juegue en tu misma: Address for whoever plays in your home: %s:%s.
El jugador elegido pasa a administrar el: The selected player becomes a server admin: they can give orders from the game chat.
El puerto %s ya está abierto en tu route: Port %s is already open on your router. It will close by itself when the server stops.
El servidor está parado: arráncalo con F: The server is stopped: start it with F5 to be able to do that.
El servidor se para un momento para rest: The server stops for a moment to restore a backup.
Elige antes a un jugador en la lista de: Select a player in the players list first.
Elige antes una cuenta en la lista de cu: Select an account in the accounts list first.
Select an invitation in the list first.
Elige la copia que quieres restaurar. An: Choose the backup you want to restore. Before restoring, what is there now is saved to another backup, just in case.
Esa invitación ya la ha usado alguien: n: Someone has already used that invitation: there is nothing to cancel.
Escribe antes una orden. La orden ayuda: Type a command first. The command help lists them all.
Escribe una orden de las de la consola y: Type one of the console commands and press Enter: help lists them all. For example players, notice and some text, kick and a name, invite, save or backup. The answer appears in the log.
Espera a que el servidor termine de arra: Wait for the server to finish starting or stopping.
Espera a que termine lo que se está haci: Wait for what is being done to finish.
Saves everything on the server to disk.
Guarda en un archivo de texto lo que hay: Saves what is in the log to a text file.
Saves what is in the log to a text file. Also with Ctrl+G.

Hace una copia de seguridad de los datos: Makes a backup of the data in the backups folder.
He abierto el puerto %s en tu router: qu: I opened port %s on your router: anyone playing from outside your home can now join with your public address. It will close when the server stops.
He pedido al router que cierre el puerto: I asked the router to close the port.
La cuenta elegida deja de administrar el: The selected account is no longer a server admin.
La cuenta elegida no podrá volver a entr: The selected account will not be able to join again. If they are inside, they are removed.
La cuenta elegida pasa a administrar el: The selected account becomes a server admin.
The selected account can join again.

Lleva el foco al campo de órdenes, en la: Moves focus to the command field, on the Log tab.
Lo oirán todos los que están dentro ahor: Everyone inside right now will hear it, with "Server notice" in front.
Lo que va diciendo el servidor: quién en: What the server keeps saying: who joins and leaves, the notices and the answers to your commands. The newest is at the end.
Los códigos de invitación, los más nuevo: The invitation codes, newest first: the free ones and those someone has already used. They work when entry to the server is by invitation. Each code is good for creating one character only.
Manda al servidor la orden escrita. Es l: Sends the typed command to the server. It's the same as pressing Enter in the field.
Mensaje del &día, el aviso que oye cada: Message of the &day, the notice each player hears on joining. Empty, none:
Message of the day changed and saved.
No encuentro la guía del servidor. Deber: I can't find the server guide. It should be in the servidor folder, named documentacion.html, or in data, docs, servidor.html.
There are no accounts in the list.
No hay ninguna invitación. Crea una con: There are no invitations. Create one with Ctrl+I.

No he podido hablar con el router: %s. L: I couldn't talk to the router: %s. The guide explains how to open the port by hand, with F1.

Stops the server and starts it again. Also with Ctrl+F5.

Para quien juegue desde fuera: tu direcc: For people playing from outside: your public address or your dynamic DNS name, a colon and port %s. You have to open that port on the router; the guide explains it step by step, with F1.
Para restaurar una copia que tienes guar: For restoring a backup you have saved in another folder or on another disk.
Parando el servidor y guardándolo todo a: Stopping the server and saving everything before closing...
Stopping the server and saving everything...
Pide al router de tu casa que abra el pu: Asks your home router to open the server port, so people can join from outside. It closes when the server stops. Not all routers allow it.
Asking the router to open the port...
Pone el servidor en marcha. También con: Starts the server. Also with F5.
Quien administra el servidor lo ha cerra: The server administrator has closed it.
Quién está dentro ahora, dónde y con qué: Who is inside now, where, and with which game version. The Applications key opens the actions for the selected player.

Saca al jugador elegido y no le deja vol: Removes the selected player and doesn't let them join again.
Saca del servidor al jugador elegido. Pu: Removes the selected player from the server. They can join again.
Removes the selected player from the server. They can join again. Also with Ctrl+E.
Se guarda en la configuración y, si el s: It is saved in the settings and, if the server is running, those inside hear it too.
Se le saca del servidor, pero puede volv: They are removed from the server, but they can join again. Leave the reason empty if you don't want to tell them anything. Cancel doesn't kick them.
Se va a borrar la cuenta de %s con su pe:
The account of %s will be deleted with its character, its houses and businesses and its place in the gang. It can't be undone.

If that person joins again, they will start from scratch. To keep them from coming back, what you need to do is ban them.

Teclas del panel del servidor\n\nF5: arr:
Server panel keys

F5: start the server.
Shift+F5: stop the server.
Ctrl+F5: restart the server.
Ctrl+P: settings.
Ctrl+Q: quit.

Ctrl+N: announcement to all players.
Ctrl+M: message to the selected player.
Ctrl+E: kick the selected player.
Ctrl+I: create an invitation.
Ctrl+D: message of the day.
Ctrl+O: type a command.
F6: refresh the lists and the status.

Ctrl+S: save now.
Ctrl+B: backup now.
Ctrl+R: restore a backup.
Ctrl+G: save the log to a file.

F1: server guide.
Ctrl+H: explains the control you are on.
Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab: switch tabs.
Alt plus the underlined letter: go to a control on the tab or open a menu.
Applications key or Shift+F10 in the players and accounts lists: actions on the selected item.
Todas las cuentas que han entrado alguna: All the accounts that have ever joined: whether they are admins, whether they are banned and when they were last seen. The Applications key opens the actions for the selected account. They can't be seen while the server is stopped.
Todas las opciones del servidor, por pes: All the server options, by tab.
Todavía no hay archivo de configuración:: There is no settings file yet: the default values are used. It is created when you save the settings.
Todavía no hay datos que copiar: el serv: There is no data to back up yet: the server has never started with this data folder.
Vuelve a leer el estado, los jugadores,: Reads the status, the players, the accounts and the invitations again.
Vuelve a leer la lista de cuentas. Tambi: Reads the accounts list again. Also with F6.
Reads the invitations list again. Also with F6.
en una localidad que el servidor no cono: in a town the server doesn't know
